offer.text: You've been on my mind more than I'd like to admit. I'd not turn away a handful of poppies from someone like you — three would do, if you're so inclined.

accept.text: Oh! Well. I'll be waiting, then. Don't keep me too long.

decline.text: Of course. Forget I said anything.

in_progress.text: Still gathering those poppies, are you?

ready.text: Poppies, for me? They're beautiful. You shouldn't have — but I'm glad you did.

complete.text: I'll press one of these in a book to remember today. Come find me again, won't you?
